Email proposal

Lead nurture refresh

A light-touch plan to add choice to every email and push the best content.

Proposal for WSC Sports · November 2026

Goal

Goal: email that warms leads up with content they choose

What we heard
  • Email warms leads up. Success is content people read, not demo requests.
  • Offer a few options instead of a single line.
  • Mix WSC pieces with topics close to what each person clicked.
Main changes
  • Each email gets a short bridge into a block of pieces, as Email 4 already does
  • Subjects, intros and order stay
  • Email 4: the demo card becomes a content piece
  • One version of each email, so content results stay clean
  • A quiet “Talk to us” line at the end of every email
  • Every link is named by topic

Email 1

Email 1: keep the study, add a bridge

Subject · The monetization gap most teams miss

Preview · How sports organizations turn moments into long-term value.

Hi Partner,

Fans now discover sports moments everywhere. Social feeds, team apps, and highlights shared seconds after they happen.

Understanding how audiences actually follow sports content has become just as important as producing it.

Our latest Fan Engagement Study looks at how different generations discover, follow, and engage with sports content today.

The study also shows where fan engagement turns into revenue. If you want to go further, here are three places to continue:

  • Fan Engagement Study: how viewing habits, platforms, and formats shape how fans stay connected
  • The Future of Watching Sports: 46% of fans see too much irrelevant content
  • What Fan Behavior Is Trying to Tell You: pre-game Stories get a 29.3% CTR

Want to talk through what this looks like for your team? Talk to us.

— The WSC Sports Team

Email 3

Email 3: new preview text and a bridge

Subject · How Sports Teams Scale Content Output

Preview · How leagues, teams and broadcasters turn live moments into highlights, stories and new formats. (NEW)

Hi Partner,

Many sports organizations are producing more content each season, yet consistency across platforms becomes harder to maintain.

Teams working with WSC Sports approach content differently. Every moment is ingested, indexed, and tagged in real time, creating a library that can generate highlights, stories, and new formats across platforms.

This approach has helped organizations increase video output, expand social reach, and create new commercial inventory from the same live moments.

Producing more only helps if it reaches fans while a moment still matters. Three pieces on speed, relevance and automation:

  • Clients page: see how leagues, teams, and broadcasters apply this model
  • Content That Misses the Moment Fails: why late content loses visibility
  • What Fans Actually Think About AI Content: 60% of Millennials see it positively

Want to talk through what this looks like for your team? Talk to us.

— The WSC Sports Team
